caption: The drawing depicts a single, symmetrical, shallow bowl or dish with an upward curving rim and two outwardly curled handles on either end. The bowl sits atop a short, wide pedestal base and is centrally positioned within a rectangular border. The drawing primarily uses grayscale pencil shading to render the bowl and its details, with additional faint yellow and blue colored pencil shading beneath the bowl, suggesting a reflection or shadow. The background is plain and uncolored, and the entire composition is neatly contained within a simple, single-line rectangular frame. The drawing has a significant amount of empty space below the bowl, emphasizing the object’s central placement.
title: Silver Salt Cellars
